meta.name: auditing-aws-s3-bucket-permissions
meta.description: Systematically audit AWS S3 bucket permissions to identify publicly accessible buckets, overly permissive ACLs, misconfigured bucket policies, and missing encryption settings using AWS CLI, S3audit, and Prowler to enforce least-privilege data access controls.

copy.tagline: 检查并收紧 AWS S3 存储桶的访问权限
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保 S3 存储桶没有公开暴露或配置错误。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and tighten AWS S3 bucket access permissions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure S3 buckets are not publicly exposed or misconfigured.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你审计 AWS S3 存储桶的权限设置，找出哪些桶是公开可访问的、ACL 或桶策略过于宽松、缺少加密或版本控制等问题，并生成审计报告。
howto.when: 当你需要检查 AWS 账户中 S3 存储桶的安全性，例如新账户上线、合规审查或收到数据泄露警报时。

say.text: 审计我 AWS 账户里所有 S3 桶的公开访问权限。
say.note: Claude 会列出公开桶并给出修复建议。

say.text: 检查 marketing-assets-prod 桶的 ACL 和策略。
say.note: Claude 会分析该桶的具体配置。

say.text: 运行 Prowler 的 S3 安全检查。
say.note: Claude 会执行 CIS 基准检查并输出结果。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you audit AWS S3 bucket permissions, identifying publicly accessible buckets, overly permissive ACLs or bucket policies, missing encryption or versioning, and generate an audit report.
howto.when_en: When you need to check the security of S3 buckets in your AWS account, such as during new account onboarding, compliance reviews, or after a data exposure alert.

say_en.text: Audit all S3 buckets in my AWS account for public access.
say_en.note: Claude will list public buckets and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: Check ACL and policy of the marketing-assets-prod bucket.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze that bucket's configuration.
Claude will execute CIS benchmark checks and output results.
